meta.description: SO(10) uplifts R^10_n of cumulative SO(9) sums R^9_n = sum_{i<=n} r^9_i (Bars hep-th/9503228 Sec. III.B).
meta.conventions: ambient2 = doubled orthogonal highest weight with l5 >= 0 (conjugation-class representative); dynkin = Sage WeylCharacterRing('D5', style='coroots'). For conjugate_pair classes the multiplicity may be split freely between lambda and its conjugate. Canonical = maximiser of H = sum c * (10 l1 + 3 l2 + 2 l3 + l4), ties broken by lex-max over classes ordered by (height, l5) descending. The canonical uplift equals the hardcoded baseline for n <= 10 (checked in verify_R10.py, not used here).
